aiModelsLoadError: Could not load this tenant’s AI models.
aiModelsMenuEmpty: This tenant has no AI models available: the {{tierLabel}} tier grants none (or the ones it grants are disabled), and this tenant has no additional grants. Package or re-enable a model on the tier (its AI Models tab), or grant one to this tenant, before assigning a model here.
aiRateDescription: Rate ceiling for AI inference requests. Leave blank to inherit the platform default.
aiRoutingCheckboxLabel: Allow external AI routing for NL→rule authoring
aiRoutingDescription: Consent to send this tenant's rule descriptions to an external AI model for drafting. Off by default; rule drafting stays unavailable for the tenant until this is granted.
aiRoutingOffNotice: External AI routing is off for this tenant (Settings tab). Assignments here are saved, but the tenant cannot draft rules until it is enabled.
deleteTenantConfirm: Delete “{{token}}”? Sign-in is revoked immediately and this cannot be undone. The tenant’s devices, dashboards and history are erased in the background afterwards, which takes at least 12 hours. The token “{{token}}” stays reserved until that finishes, and becomes available again once it does.
description: The instance's tenant registry. A tenant is a control-plane record, not a provisioned resource.
effectiveDefaultDisabled: No model assigned. The tier’s default ({{model}}) is disabled, so nothing takes the call — this function is unavailable for the tenant.
effectiveNoDefault: No model assigned and the {{tierLabel}} tier marks no default — this function is unavailable for the tenant. Assign a model above, or set a default on the tier.
effectiveOffMenu: Assigned {{model}}, which is no longer on this tenant’s menu — it resolves to no model until you pick an available one or the model is granted again.
effectiveTierDefault: No model assigned — falls back to the tier default, {{model}}.
empty: No tenants yet. Create the first one to get started.
heldCeilingDescription: Most commands this tenant may have waiting to be delivered — both those still on their way out and those held for devices that are offline. Leave blank to inherit the tier's ceiling, then the platform default — which is a real limit, never unlimited.
inheritDefaultHint: Leave blank to inherit the platform default.
noModelsOnMenu: No models on this tenant’s menu.
outboundRateDescription: Rate ceiling for outbound connector actions. Leave blank to inherit the platform default.
shedPriorityDescription: Which tenants keep running longest when the platform is under strain and has to shed load (1–100 — higher survives longer). A preference, not a limit: it changes the order tenants are degraded in, never how much they may do. Leave blank to inherit the tier's band, then the platform default.
settingsExplanation: What this tenant is metered at, and where each limit comes from. A setting falls back from its own override, to the <tierLink>{{tier}}</tierLink> tier, to the platform default — which is a real limit, never unlimited.
tenantDeletedToast: Tenant “{{token}}” deleted — sign-in revoked, data erasure to follow
tierDescriptionCreate: The packaging this tenant is held to. Sets its defaults across the platform; individual settings below can still override them.
tierDescriptionEdit: The packaging this tenant is held to. Changing it applies within a minute.
title: Tenants
tokenDescription: The tenant id used across the platform; it cannot change.
deletionNotStartedYet: Reclamation has not started yet. It begins within a minute of the delete, and this panel will fill in on its own.
deletionSummaryComplete: Erasure complete. {{rows}} records were erased and the token has been released for reuse.
deletionSummarySettling: All storage systems report clean. Confirming nothing further arrives, for about another {{amount}} {{unit}}.
deletionSummaryTokenHold: Data reclamation is complete. The token “{{token}}” becomes available again in about {{amount}} {{unit}}.
deletionSummaryFinishing: All checks have passed. The deletion completes on the next sweep.
remedyDetect: Start the event-processing service so it can release this tenant's detection state.
remedyBlob: Configure object storage, or remove the object out of band.
deletionsDescription: Every tenant deletion on this instance, newest first. A record outlives the tenant it describes, so completed deletions are listed here rather than on a tenant page.
deletionsEmpty: No tenant has been deleted on this instance.
fenceCeilingDescription: How many geofences this tenant may keep. Each one is announced to the platform when the set changes, and the announcement has to fit a single message, which is what limits it. Leave blank to inherit the tier's cap, then the platform default.
fencePositionBudgetDescription: How many points this tenant's geofences may add up to across the whole set. This one is a claim on room the platform shares between every tenant — it keeps all of their fences ready to test incoming positions against — so the platform's own limit on it is lower relative to the default than the others. Leave blank to inherit the tier's cap, then the platform default.
fencePositionCeilingDescription: How many points a single geofence may have. Checking a fence for self-crossings costs time that grows with the square of its point count, so a very detailed outline is slow to accept and slow to reload. Leave blank to inherit the tier's cap, then the platform default.
fenceCapMaximumHint: Each of these three has a platform maximum as well; a larger number is refused rather than quietly reduced.
